decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 roughly unchanged — no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold and there's no strong multi-signal setup among candidates, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and skipping new buys rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ slipping a modest 0.3% and the S&P 500 nearly flat. There was no dominant macro catalyst driving the session, reflecting a market in a holding pattern as investors await clearer directional signals. Low-conviction, low-volume days like this typically favor patience over forced positioning.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市大致橫行整理，納指微跌0.3%，標普500指數則幾乎持平。市場缺乏明顯的主導性消息面刺激，反映投資者在等待更清晰的方向訊號前選擇觀望。此類低成交量、低確信度的交易日，通常更適合按兵不動而非勉強進場。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off doesn't always mean a market crash — it can simply mean conditions aren't compelling enough to justify new risk. On a neutral day with limited cash and no strong confirming signals, the disciplined move is to hold existing positions and preserve capital rather than chase momentum that isn't really there.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）不一定代表市場暴跌，有時只是代表現時環境未足以支持承擔新風險。在大市中性、資金有限且缺乏強力確認訊號的情況下，較穩健的做法是持有現有倉位、保留資本，而非勉強追逐並不存在的動能。
